adapters.how_to_enable: Add the key under Settings → External services
adapters.notes: Google Lens requires a publicly reachable image URL; uses the media URL of a captured location.

adapters.name: serpapi_web
adapters.title: Google web search via SerpAPI (caption/text)
adapters.how_to_enable: Add the key under Settings → External services
